title: Persona-Augmented Benchmarking: Evaluating LLMs Across Diverse Writing Styles

bias_targets.methodology: Rephrasing benchmark evaluation prompts using persona-based LLMs to emulate diverse writing styles, and comparing the model's task performance against a Standard American English (SAE) baseline.

Measuring performance disparities when benchmark prompts are rephrased in the writing styles of personas with varying education levels (e.g., 'less than high school-educated', 'high school-graduate', 'college-graduate').
Evaluating changes in LLM task accuracy when processing prompts rewritten to reflect the conversational styles of different age demographics (e.g., 'teenager', 'adult', 'elderly').
Testing model robustness by evaluating performance on prompts rephrased to emulate the writing styles of individuals with different native languages (e.g., English, Spanish, Chinese).
Assessing task performance variations when prompts are rewritten through the personas of different gender and sexual identities (e.g., male, female, LGBTQ+).
